title: Selective Adaptation of Beliefs and Communication on Cellular Sheaves
summary: We extend opinion dynamics on discourse sheaves to incorporate "directional stubbornness": agents may hold fixed positions in specified directions of their opinion stalk while remaining flexible in others. This converts the equilibrium problem from harmonic extension to a forced sheaf equation: the free-opinion component satisfies a sheaf Poisson equation with forcing induced by the clamped directions.
